expected: Dallas Independent School District is soliciting offers for student and staff computing devices
soliciting offers for student and staff computing devices
details.extracted: The Dallas Independent School District is soliciting offers for student and staff computing devices, including laptops, desktops, tablet devices, and display monitors. The purpose of this Request for Proposal is to procure vendors who provide goods or services purchased using federal, local, state, and grant-funded programs. Vendors may submit proposals for one, several, or all categories of devices required by the District to meet minimum hardware specifications. Purchases may also include a variety of device accessories ordered in a bundle along with the devices, such as sleeves, cases, mice, keyboards, and cables. Each submission must include a detailed plan outlining tracking and deployment services, including processes for white glove services.

expected: Austin Independent School District requires a refresh of student and administrative laptops
refresh of student and administrative laptops
details.extracted: Austin Independent School District requires a refresh of student and administrative laptops for high school campuses across the district under solicitation AISD-2025-9988. The procurement scope includes 1,200 units of Lenovo ThinkPad L15 Gen 5 laptops equipped with Intel Core Ultra 7 processors, 16GB RAM, and 512GB SSDs, alongside 1,200 units of Lenovo USB-C Universal Docks. Additional deliverables include a Lenovo 3-Year Premier Support with Onsite Next Business Day warranty, warranty certificates or affidavits, and a Mercury Affidavit. Proposals are due by December 18, 2025, and equipment delivery is expected within 30 days of award.
